states.title: Data state by dataset
states.subtitle: Six answers per dataset: what is valid, what is behind, what we did not ask for, what the provider does not have, what we asked for and failed, and what we hold but could not normalise.
states.legend: Valid, behind, not requested and provider-without-data count entities (fixtures, teams, players...). Request failed counts failed or partial runs in the last 24 h. Normalisation failed counts open issues: rejected rows, unknown provider entities and unresolved results. The provider's lag or absence is not our failure.

awaiting_result.title: Fixtures past kick-off without a result, not asked again
awaiting_result.detail: Recorded as scheduled or live after kick-off and not re-asked since the match should have ended: results_repair is behind.

awaiting_result_provider.title: Fixtures the provider has not finalised yet
awaiting_result_provider.detail: Asked again after the match should have ended; the provider still says not played. A result can take up to 48 h for some competitions; nothing for us to fix.

stale_running_jobs.title: Runs stuck in 'running'
stale_running_jobs.detail: Open past their deadline: the process that owned them most likely died. The run watchdog closes them within five minutes; one that stays here means the watchdog itself is not running.

failed_jobs_24h.title: Failed runs (24 h)
failed_jobs_24h.detail: Runs that finished with errors and nothing durable. Runs stopped at their planned cap are not failures and are counted apart.

stale_jobs_24h.title: Runs closed as stale (24 h)
stale_jobs_24h.detail: Open past their deadline and closed by the run watchdog: a job that hangs.

partial_jobs_24h.title: Partially successful runs (24 h)
partial_jobs_24h.detail: Runs that wrote something AND hit errors.

stale_fixtures.title: Upcoming fixtures with a price older than their last capture window
stale_fixtures.detail: A capture window has closed since the newest price and /odds was not asked again: the capture is behind.

missed_fixtures.title: Priced fixtures that passed a capture window without a price
missed_fixtures.detail: The provider lists them as priced, a window has closed and /odds was not asked: the next capture run catches them up while they are still to be played.

fixtures_without_lineage.title: Fixtures without payload lineage
fixtures_without_lineage.detail: Last written before revision 0015; the payload that wrote them is not linked. The next sync or a raw replay records it.

budget_exhausted.title: Daily request budget exhausted
budget_exhausted.detail: No provider request will be issued until the UTC day rolls over.
